Provenance.drafts: 8 candidates across 2 rounds (4 + 4 escalation) generated locally via ComfyUI MCP; curated per art/pipeline/README.md.
Provenance.paintoverNote: c3 (seed+3, round 1) -- a standing hound with a rust-orange masked face/body pattern, a calm closed-mouth expression, and a worked-metal collar/chain (not in the written spec, but reads as guard-dog decoration rather than a contradiction). c0/c1 (round 1) had correct hound anatomy but a snarling bared-teeth expression that conflicts with this venue's Cult-of-the-Lamb 'sympathetic' rule; c2 (round 1) was a multi-panel furnace-prop grid, not a hound at all. A round-2 escalation toward 'chubby rounded chibi proportions' (c4-c7) produced striking round-bodied designs but every one drifted into a robot/mech/golem body plan with no canine features at all, losing the 'hound' identity entirely -- c3 was kept as the strongest literal match to the written 'single molten-slag hound' subject.
Provenance.aiDisclosure: AI-generated (SDXL base 1.0) diffuse, background-removed via BiRefNet (cutout.py --trim); normal map derived via normalmap.py (Sobel height-from-luminance, strength 2.5) -- lit Monster world sprite per AssetSpec.NormalMap=true. Passed on the existing Flip-Y-OFF import convention (unchanged script/settings, not independently re-swept this wave).
